summary: Build a modern, professional, industrial-themed (blue/white) marketing website for a B2B packaging material manufacturing company, including homepage hero/CTA, company overview, product listings, trust/value propositions, and contact options, with mobile-friendly, fast-loading, SEO-optimized requirements.
architectural_notes: Use blue and white color theme with an industrial, trustworthy, business-oriented visual style
Prioritize performance for fast loading (lightweight assets, optimized images)
Implement basic SEO best practices (semantic HTML, meta tags, headings)
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Industrial packaging factory/warehouse hero banner, blue-and-white tones (hero-banner.dim_1920x800.png)
- Simple modern logo mark for a packaging manufacturer, blue-and-white (logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Corrugated box icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-corrugated.dim_512x512.png)
- Carton box icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-carton.dim_512x512.png)
- Bubble wrap icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-bubblewrap.dim_512x512.png)
- Packaging roll icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-rolls.dim_512x512.png)
- Custom printed packaging icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-custom-printed.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a modern, professional, industrial and trustworthy blue/white website theme and apply it consistently across all sections (typography, spacing, buttons, section backgrounds, and icon style).

Implement the marketing site structure with a clear navigation (header with links) and the following sections: Homepage (hero + intro + primary CTA), About Us, Products, Why Choose Us, and Contact. Support smooth in-page navigation to sections.

Build the Homepage hero with a large banner, the exact tagline “Strong Packaging. Safe Delivery. Trusted Quality.”, a short company introduction, and a clearly visible “Contact Us” button that navigates to the Contact section.
Create an About Us section describing the company as reliable, quality-focused, and a bulk supplier for B2B clients, explicitly mentioning competitive pricing and timely delivery.
Create a Products section that lists and briefly describes these product categories: Corrugated Boxes, Carton Packaging, Bubble Wrap, Packaging Rolls, Custom Printed Packaging.
Create a “Why Choose Us” section highlighting: Premium Quality Materials, Bulk Supply Capability, On-Time Delivery, Affordable Pricing.

Create a Contact section that displays Phone: 7050223696, Email: p1204631@gmail.com, includes a simple contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message), includes a WhatsApp contact button, and shows the call-to-action text “Contact us today for bulk orders and custom packaging solutions.”
Wire the frontend contact form to the backend submission API with user feedback (loading, success, and error states) and ensure form submission is fast and does not block the UI.
Ensure the site is mobile-friendly and fast-loading: responsive layouts, optimized images, and no unnecessary heavy assets. Maintain good accessibility for navigation and form controls.

Add basic SEO optimizations for a single-page marketing site: meaningful page title, meta description, semantic headings (H1/H2), and Open Graph/Twitter meta tags appropriate for a packaging manufacturing company.

Add generated static image assets to support the industrial theme (hero banner, logo, and simple product category icons) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images via the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Homepage with large hero banner, tagline (“Strong Packaging. Safe Delivery. Trusted Quality.”), short intro, and prominent “Contact Us” button
Add About Us section describing reliability, quality focus, B2B bulk supply, competitive pricing, and timely delivery
Add Products section listing Corrugated Boxes, Carton Packaging, Bubble Wrap, Packaging Rolls, and Custom Printed Packaging
Add “Why Choose Us” section with Premium Quality Materials, Bulk Supply Capability, On-Time Delivery, Affordable Pricing
Add Contact section with phone (7050223696), email (p1204631@gmail.com), contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message), WhatsApp button, and CTA text for bulk/custom orders
Ensure site is mobile-friendly, fast-loading, and SEO-optimized

Implement backend support to accept contact form submissions and persist them in the canister so submissions are not lost on refresh. Provide a safe, minimal API to create a contact message and optionally list messages for future admin use.
